sections.description: The Project Manager theme provides a structured layout designed to organize project-related content, team information, timelines, and service details. It includes responsive page templates, customizable homepage sections, content blocks, and navigation menus that help arrange information clearly across different devices. Built-in customization settings allow adjustments to colors, typography, headers, and layouts without modifying core files. The theme also supports image galleries, blog sections, contact forms, and widget-ready areas for additional functionality. The layout is designed with readability and content organization in mind, allowing information such as project updates, milestones, schedules, and team profiles to be displayed in a structured format. Additional features include search functionality, social media integration, customizable footers, and multiple page templates for presenting various types of content. Responsive design ensures a consistent viewing experience on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices. Compatibility with modern browsers and commonly used plugins helps extend functionality when required. The theme focuses on maintaining clear navigation, organized spacing, and flexible content presentation while supporting a wide range of website structures and informational pages.
